findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "get_metrics_history" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Daily-or-sparser history of an extension's numbers: user count, rating and ratings count, each as a map of ISO date to value. "listings" is this extension's own…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_catalog, get_listing · Private data: list_extensions · Public sink: get_extension, search_catalog, get_listing · Destructive: remove_keyword, remove_competitor, list_scrape_runs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_catalog, get_listing · Private data: list_extensions · Public sink: get_extension, search_catalog, get_listing · Destructive: remove_keyword, remove_competitor, list_scrape_runs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
